body.message:
Sure, we will inform our team that you will make the payment on the 2nd and update the Upside team accordingly.

As you are one of our long-stay guests, we will make an exception and hold the extension until then.

For now, your booking will remain until the 2nd, and once the payment is received, we will proceed with the further extension.

Thank you, Khashayar, and we look forward to seeing you on 2nd September.
